title: Nanairo no Rasengan
body:
Syntax: perform nanairo no rasengan <target>

Description: Seven independently rolled colors strike the target. The caster's matching chakra nature strengthens that one color; soul can poison and dark can blind. A level-cap Rasengan with seven separate strike rolls: fire, water, earth, wind, lightning, soul, and dark. A matching chakra nature strengthens its own color. Soul can poison and dark can blind; one cast pays one Chakra cost. Usable with any chakra nature. Base damage: 1471-1528. Unlocks at level 100. Costs 120 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 25 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
